cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says Kenyan banks or payment providers send and receive payments through PAPSS.
cells.note: The CBK licenses payment service providers (March 2026) and regulates Kenswitch, a domestic switch connecting banks, SACCOs, microfinance institutions and mobile money providers (November 2026), so stage 4. No live PAPSS participation has been found, so not 5.
